items.title: Arcadia HiRISE stereo terrain model
items.provider: NASA / JPL / University of Arizona / USGS
items.processing: Average resampling into a local Mars azimuthal-equidistant 20 m grid; central-difference slope; unsupported derivatives and no-data excluded.

items.provider: NASA / JPL / Arizona State University / USGS
